final: WITH project_ratios AS (SELECT p.arcregistry, p.fundflux, AVG(s.boxx / NULLIF(s.boxz, 0)) AS ratio FROM projects AS p JOIN scanspatial AS s ON s.arcref = p.arcregistry GROUP BY p.arcregistry, p.fundflux), funding_averages AS (SELECT fundflux, AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM project_ratios GROUP BY fundflux) SELECT pr.arcregistry AS project_id, pr.fundflux AS funding_source, pr.ratio, pr.ratio - fa.avg_ratio AS margin FROM project_ratios AS pr JOIN funding_averages AS fa ON pr.fundflux = fa.fundflux WHERE pr.ratio > fa.avg_ratio ORDER BY margin DESC LIMIT 10
